look_here_first: Start with scale and habitat: small lavender-violet flowers on slender branched stems in wet alluvial or coastal-prairie settings; sharp calyx lobes and an orange-haired exserted staminode are key details.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: perennial with slender erect branched stems

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: opposite sessile oblong to lanceolate leaves

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: exserted staminode with orange distal hairs

lookalikes.differences: Much smaller-flowered and wetter-site than P. cobaea, P. triflorus, or woody-based P. baccharifolius.
